display.purpose: Card titles, page headers, the wordmark. Space Grotesk carries all instrument-panel headline moments.

body.purpose: Descriptive prose, match text, general copy. Public Sans, 1.6 line-height for readability.

label.purpose: Field labels, badges, uppercase tags — small, deliberate, always paired with a control.

mono.purpose: Precise literal tokens only: timecodes, path mappings, restore-row chips.

stat.purpose: The Stat Display Exception: one glanceable number/code as a card's sole subject — the cached-title-count stat (26px) and the Plex PIN badge (34px, set in mono instead of display).

shadows.name: card-float
shadows.purpose: The one floating-above-chassis surface per view — wizard/settings card, generate-grid cards.

shadows.name: result-dropdown
shadows.purpose: Floating search-results/match-list dropdown anchored under an input.

motion.name: ease-control
motion.purpose: Default transition for borders, colors, backgrounds — firm and immediate, no elastic/spring easing.

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Button hover/active lift (translateY(-1px) to translateY(0)) paired with brightness(1.06).

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Mobile sidebar drawer slide (left: -240px to left: 0).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Phosphor Teal call-to-action button with a firm lift-and-brighten hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; background: oklch(0.84 0.14 174); color: oklch(0.16 0.02 174); transition: transform 150ms ease, filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.84 0.14 174 / 0.13); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No-background secondary action, used for cancel/skip.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: none; border: none; color: oklch(0.50 0.012 250); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: oklch(0.93 0.006 250); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.84 0.14 174); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field input with the system's accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: oklch(0.245 0.014 250); border: 1px solid oklch(0.33 0.015 250); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: oklch(0.93 0.006 250); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.50 0.012 250); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.84 0.14 174); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.84 0.14 174 / 0.13); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Persistent sidebar navigation row with an active teal-wash state.
components.css: .ds-navitem-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: oklch(0.84 0.14 174 / 0.13); color: oklch(0.84 0.14 174); transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-navitem-active:hover { background: oklch(0.84 0.14 174 / 0.18); } .ds-navitem-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.84 0.14 174); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Style Pill (selected)
components.description: Selectable style-preset chip; checked state gets a border-and-wash pair, never a plain color swap.
components.css: .ds-style-pill-checked { display: block; padding: 9px 4px; text-align: center; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; background: oklch(0.84 0.14 174 / 0.13); border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.84 0.14 174); color: oklch(0.84 0.14 174); transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-style-pill-checked:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Clip Preview Card
components.description: The system's signature component: a 16:9 media box with a blurred status badge overlay and a bottom-scrim caption overlay for the burned-in quote preview.
components.html:
GIF · 4s
"May the Force be with you."
components.css: .ds-clip-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/9; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(160deg, oklch(0.24 0.02 260), oklch(0.13 0.015 260)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-clip-badge { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: white; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-clip-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.84 0.14 174); } .ds-clip-caption { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 20px 18px 14px; background: linear-gradient(to top, oklch(0 0 0 / 0.65), transparent); text-align: center; } .ds-clip-caption span { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: white; text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The system's one floating surface — the only element carrying the Card Float shadow.
components.html:
Connect Plex

Enter your Plex server details to continue.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 100%; max-width: 460px; background: oklch(0.205 0.013 250); border: 1px solid oklch(0.27 0.013 250); border-radius: 14px; padding: 40px 36px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 6px; color: oklch(0.93 0.006 250); } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.68 0.012 250); margin: 0; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
CineSnip's web app is a precision instrument panel, not a marketing surface: a near-black chassis with a single glowing indicator color reserved for what's active, valid, or selected right now. Every other surface — cards, inputs, the sidebar — sits in a tight band of near-neutral dark tones, so the one accent (Phosphor Teal) reads unmistakably as "this is the thing that matters" whether that's a completed wizard step, a selected style preset, or the currently-playing clip preview. The two shells it runs — the wizard's centered single-card flow and the app-shell's persistent sidebar — are two panels of the same instrument, not two different products.

The mood is technical and precise, not glossy. Borders are thin and exact rather than soft; hover states are a firm lift-and-brighten, not a fade; motion is short and functional (150ms transitions, no easing flourishes beyond what a physical control needs). This deliberately steers away from two common self-hosted-tool traps: the generic blue/purple gradient SaaS-admin look, and glossy corporate marketing polish. CineSnip should read like a tool an enthusiast built for their own Plex server, not a startup's dashboard product.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black chassis (bg/surface/surface-2/sidebar) with one reserved accent color, never a secondary or tertiary hue
Thin, exact borders over soft shadows; the one heavy shadow in the system is reserved for cards/panels floating above the chassis
Tactile, confident interactive states — buttons lift on hover, inputs get a focus ring, selected items get an accent border, never just a color swap alone
Monospace used narrowly and meaningfully: timecodes, path mappings, PIN codes — anywhere the value is a precise machine-readable token, not prose

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Phosphor Teal marks exactly one thing at a time per view: what's active, selected, valid, or complete. It is never used decoratively or for anything at rest — if nothing is selected/active/complete, nothing on screen is teal.

rules.name: The Danger Is Foreign Rule
rules.body: oklch(0.68 0.18 25) (red-orange) exists solely for errors and destructive actions. It is the only other saturated hue in the system and must never be reused for anything else, so its appearance is always unambiguous.

rules.name: The Precision Token Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for values a user might type, copy, or compare character-by-character (timecodes, paths, PINs). It is never used for prose or labels, even short ones.

rules.name: The Stat Display Exception
rules.body: Display's 19-22px ceiling is for headings. A card whose entire purpose is one glanceable number or code (a PIN, a live count) may go larger -- up to 34px -- but only when that number/code is the card's single subject, never as emphasis on body or label text.

rules.name: The Radius-Follows-Size Rule
rules.body: A surface's corner radius scales with its own footprint: small controls (6–8px) sit inside larger containers (10–14px) — never the reverse, and never a uniform radius across every level.

rules.name: The Flat Interior Rule
rules.body: Nothing nested inside a card casts its own shadow. Depth inside a card comes only from the surface/surface-2 tonal step and a border — shadows are reserved for things floating above the chassis itself.

dos: Do treat Phosphor Teal as a single reserved signal — active, selected, valid, complete — never decorative.
Do pair every selection/active state with both a border-color change and a background wash together.
Do use monospace only for precise, literal tokens (timecodes, paths, PINs), never for prose.
Do scale corner radius up with container size — small controls inside larger ones always get a smaller radius.
Do keep card interiors flat; reserve shadow for the outermost floating surface per view.
Do use firm, physical hover motion (lift + brighten) rather than opacity fades.
donts: Don't introduce a second or third accent hue — the palette's entire expressive range is one teal against near-neutral dark tones.
Don't reuse the danger red-orange for anything other than errors/destructive actions.
Don't add gradient-heavy, glossy, or corporate-SaaS styling — cards, buttons, and chrome stay flat and precise.
Don't give a nested surface (input, pill, row) its own shadow — depth there comes from tonal steps only.
Don't use a uniform border-radius across every component regardless of size.
